title: Removing molluscum contagiosum in a child
also: small bumps on a child's skin
what: Molluscum contagiosum is small smooth bumps on the skin caused by a virus. Often they go away by themselves, but sometimes the doctor removes them.
why: When there are many bumps, they grow, become inflamed, bother your child or spread to other children.
duration: the procedure usually takes 10 to 30 minutes; without treatment the bumps themselves go away over months
tell_doctor: How many bumps there are, where they are and how long they have been there
If your child has eczema or other skin diseases
If your child is very afraid of procedures

prepare.title: Decision
prepare.text: Whether to remove or wait is for you to decide with the doctor. Sometimes watching is chosen.

prepare.title: Numbing
prepare.text: Often a numbing cream is applied under a film 30 to 60 minutes before - ask the clinic.

prepare.title: Talk
prepare.text: Calmly tell your child what will happen. Bring a favorite toy.

prepare.title: Skin
prepare.text: Do not squeeze the bumps at home - this spreads the virus.

steps: The doctor examines the skin and chooses a method
The skin is treated with antiseptic
The bumps are removed with a small curette (spoon), cold or a special solution
If there is slight bleeding, it is pressed with gauze
The spots are treated with antiseptic
feel: With numbing cream it is usually unpleasant but bearable
Your child may cry from fear more than from pain - stay close
after: Treat the spots as your doctor said
Do not let your child scratch or rub the spots
Give your child a separate towel, washcloth and clothes
New bumps may appear - show them to the doctor
red_flags: Redness, swelling or pus around the spots, or fever - see a doctor
Bumps near the eye or on the eyelid - see a doctor, do not touch them yourself

faq.q: Can my child go to the pool and to nursery?
faq.a: Nursery is usually fine. For the pool, ask your doctor; it is better to cover the bumps.

faq.q: Will molluscum go away by itself?
faq.a: Most often yes, but it can take months. You decide about removal with the doctor.

reminders.text: Molluscum removal soon. If the doctor said so, apply the numbing cream. Take a toy for your child.
